methodology: A forward-looking record of real, sourced signals that a new tenant is moving into a Nashville space. A successor is a factual claim: an entry exists only from an operator-maintained signal that carries a new-tenant name, a dated signal and a cited source; nothing is auto-inferred from the closure record, which is used only to corroborate a stated predecessor (predecessor_confirmed). A tenant is asserted as moving in only when status is 'confirmed'; every other entry is marked speculative and never stated as fact. No personal data.
